result.quote: “You must never again go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”
result.reason: Verse 21:17 directly gives this as David’s men’s reason. The question is natural and asks for their stated purpose; no materially different reason appears in the window. The edit preserves the original focus on protecting David so Israel would not lose its leader, expressed here through the verse’s lamp metaphor.
